# SQLite probe — the questions the query language cannot ask

**GENERATED by `python3 sqlite_probe.py`** from `web/nordstern.json`, `Engpass/obstacles/` and `attempts/`. **Never shipped to `web/`** — the site stays static and served from `slim.js`.

Records are stored as whole JSON documents with **virtual generated columns** indexing into them, so no derived value is ever written down: `json_extract` computes on read and cannot drift from the document. That is derive-never-store enforced by the storage layer rather than by discipline.

## 5. The attempts drafts

31 attempts across 2 diseases, from `attempts/*.yaml`. These are drafts and nothing validates them.

| outcome | n | earliest | latest |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `negative` | 16 | 1997 | 2024 |

| `positive` | 4 | 2001 | 2024 |
| `ambiguous` | 2 | 1993 | 2018 |
| `in-flight` | 1 | 2023 | 2023 |

### The chains

`follows` links a confirmatory readout to the result that motivated it. **The gap between them measures how long a field held a belief that did not survive** — the one figure in these files a funder would want.

- **sepsis** · drotrecogin alfa (activated protein C) — drotrecogin alfa PROWESS (2001) → 2012 · **11 years**
- **sepsis** · early goal-directed therapy — early goal-directed therapy (2001) → 2015 · **14 years**
- **sepsis** · low-dose hydrocortisone — high-dose corticosteroids (1987) → 2018 · **31 years**
- **parkinsons** · exenatide — exenatide phase 2 (2017) → 2024 · **7 years**

### Cross-references, checked against the register

The drafts **assert** `against` and `succeeded_elsewhere`. Engpass's rule is that such a link must be *derived*, because a stored one can drift. Until it is, this at least checks that every named record exists.

*(every cross-referenced record exists)*
- `creatine` — *also-tried-in* → **huntington** (`unsolved`)
- `high-dose corticosteroids` — *succeeded-in* → **covid-19** (`curable`)
- `anti-TNF antibodies and TNF receptor fusion proteins` — *succeeded-in* → **crohns** (`managed`)
- `anti-TNF antibodies and TNF receptor fusion proteins` — *succeeded-in* → **rheumatoid-arthritis** (`managed`)
- `interleukin-1 receptor antagonist (anakinra)` — *succeeded-in* → **rheumatoid-arthritis** (`managed`)

## 6. One record naming another as a cause

**The guard the register did not have.** `hearing-loss` listed the infectious causes of childhood deafness and omitted congenital CMV, its largest — and nothing found it, because every existing check tests a record against itself or against a derivation (gaps.md #242).

A bare mention is not a finding: `stroke` and `tuberculosis` appear in dozens of records as comparisons. **Requiring causal language near the name** cuts 254 raw mentions to 53.

- **53** causal cross-record claims
- 15 already cite the other record's slug
- 24 are mentioned back by the other record, under some name
- **23 are neither linked nor reciprocated** — the work-list below

### Records named as a cause by others, ranked

| named record | claims against it | by |
|---|---:|---|
| **`heart-failure`** | 3 | duchenne, influenza, mesothelioma |
| **`colorectal-cancer`** | 2 | cervical-cancer, pancreatic-cancer |
| **`measles`** | 2 | childhood-pneumonia, influenza |
| **`stroke`** | 2 | bladder-cancer, lung-cancer |

**The current head of the list is `heart-failure`**, named as a cause by 3 records that it does not name back — the shape the CMV and obesity omissions both had.

**Two have already been fixed this way**: `hearing-loss`, which listed the infectious causes of childhood deafness and omitted congenital CMV; and `obesity`, which said *roughly thirteen cancers* where every other downstream record was named by slug. **A number is not a link, and a count is the form an omission takes when it looks like precision.**

### The full work-list

**Roughly half are false positives and the classes are predictable**: comparison prose (*"unlike X"*, *"the same arithmetic as X"*), shared risk-factor lists, and sub-entity collisions — *portal hypertension* matching the `hypertension` record. Read, do not apply.

- `uterine-cancer` → **`breast-cancer`** — …breast cancer \u2014 which is a held record whose treatment causes…
- `cervical-cancer` → **`colorectal-cancer`** — …precursor, as in colorectal cancer…
- `pancreatic-cancer` → **`colorectal-cancer`** — …precursor problem here runs backwards from colorectal cancer…
- `influenza` → **`dengue`** — …dengue \u2014 *do not get it, because…
- `onchocerciasis` → **`epilepsy`** — …causes epilepsy…
- `duchenne` → **`heart-failure`** — …heart failure is now the leading cause…
- `influenza` → **`heart-failure`** — …cause **the deaths are certified as pneumonia, heart failure…
- `mesothelioma` → **`heart-failure`** — …cause breathlessness from an effusion is investigated as infection or heart failure…
- `cirrhosis` → **`hypertension`** — …causing portal hypertension…
- `prostate-cancer` → **`ischaemic-heart-disease`** — …cause unlike ischaemic heart disease…
- `bladder-cancer` → **`lung-cancer`** — …driven by it after ischaemic heart disease, stroke, COPD and lung cancer…
- `cerebral-palsy` → **`malaria`** — …malaria result, and it is the more disturbing of the two because…
- `childhood-pneumonia` → **`measles`** — …causes**: Hib and pneumococcal conjugate directly; measles…
- `influenza` → **`measles`** — …measles, rabies and dengue \u2014 *do not get it, because…
- `uterine-cancer` → **`melanoma`** — …cause the strata it reached are a tenth of diagnoses — the same arithmetic as melanoma…
- `uterine-cancer` → **`non-hodgkin-lymphoma`** — …cause the strata it reached are a tenth of diagnoses — the same arithmetic as melanoma's, non-Hodgkin lymphoma…
- `influenza` → **`rabies`** — …rabies and dengue \u2014 *do not get it, because…
- `soil-transmitted-helminths` → **`schistosomiasis`** — …schistosomiasis and worth recording twice because…
- `cataract` → **`smallpox`** — …cause seven other records in this register share the rating and they are things like smallpox…
- `bladder-cancer` → **`stroke`** — …driven by it after ischaemic heart disease, stroke…
- `lung-cancer` → **`stroke`** — …drives four records in this register \u2014 ischaemic heart disease, stroke…
- `yaws` → **`syphilis`** — …caused by *Treponema pallidum* subspecies *pertenue*, a near-twin of the syphilis…
- `cystic-fibrosis` → **`tuberculosis`** — …causes and frequently to tuberculosis…
